document_contents.quote: And whereas, the taxpayer submitted its reply in DRC-06, but the same is found not comprehensive, conceivable, perspicuous and also no one appeared on behalf of the firm to provide explanation/clarification with regard to the reply submitted against DRC-01.

Since, the reply filed by the taxpayer is not comprehensible, conceivable, perspicuous and ambiguous, therefore, the proposed demand mentioned in the Show Cause Notice i.e. conveyed through notice DRC-01 is confirmed.

defects_argued.quote: The challenge to Notification No. 9/2023-Central Tax dated 31 March 2023 and Notification No. 56/2023-Central Tax dated 28 December 2023 which are issued under Section 168A of the CGST Act, is kept open to be addressed in appropriate proceedings and if need so arises.

outcome.quote: We consequently allow the writ petition and quash the order dated 31 August 2024.
